title: Wait — you said pigs are...
content_text:
Wait — you said pigs are really smart. Doesn't that make the whole thing feel kind of cruel?
How do I put it... people just tend to favor dogs and cats, you know?
And now that you've told me pigs are just as smart, I don't know how to describe the feeling.
When I had a cat, I used to hold her up to the mirror — she never seemed to recognize herself.
What other animals can actually pass the mirror test?
In this sentence, I always thought managed meant to be in charge of something — but here it seems to mean something else.
Do we already have a job that covers this?
